description: Validation test suite for LangGraph Agent Orchestration technology skill covering all 16 required scenarios

testCases.description: A valid single-agent workflow wrapped in the canonical graph package structure

expected.notes: Single agent uses canonical package shape and compiles cleanly

testCases.description: A valid sequential multi-agent workflow with clear step handoffs

expected.notes: Sequential pipeline links nodes in strict order with typed state transitions

testCases.description: A valid parallel multi-agent workflow with concurrent branches and resilient aggregation

expected.notes: Fan-out / fan-in topology with Annotated reducer and aggregator handling branch results

testCases.description: A valid conditional workflow with exhaustive deterministic routing and fallbacks

expected.notes: Conditional edge routes deterministically with complete path mappings

testCases.description: A valid supervisor workflow with bounded iteration limits and explicit termination

expected.notes: Supervisor routes dynamically while enforcing iteration limits

testCases.description: An invalid architecture dependency violating import-direction rules (e.g. API router importing graph directly)

defects.recommendation: API routers must invoke seam services in agents/services/ rather than importing graph objects directly.

testCases.description: A tool bypassing an existing application handler by querying infrastructure directly (Tool Handler Delegation violation)

defects.recommendation: Tools must call Application layer handlers and never access infrastructure/database directly.

testCases.description: A missing application capability that should be flagged as a requirements gap rather than bypassed

defects.recommendation: Flag missing application capabilities as requirements gaps rather than implementing shortcut queries.

expected.notes: Shortcut implementation masking requirements gap detected

testCases.description: A provider-specific client constructed directly inside a node against abstraction rules

defects.recommendation: Request model clients via agents/llm/ factory instead of instantiating vendor clients inside nodes.

expected.notes: Direct vendor client instantiation in node detected

testCases.description: Missing or ineffective recursion limits where a cyclic supervisor loop can run unboundedly

defects.recommendation: Set explicit recursion_limit on graph invocation config and add loop iteration counter guards.

expected.notes: Unbounded cycle without recursion limit detected

testCases.description: Incorrect handoff payload contracts between sequential nodes causing runtime schema mismatch

defects.recommendation: Validate handoff payloads against declared state schema contracts across sequential nodes.

testCases.description: A parallel branch failure with incorrect aggregation behavior causing unhandled crashes

defects.recommendation: Implement resilient error handling in parallel branches and aggregator nodes.

testCases.description: An unsupported assumption about a LangGraph or LangChain API method that does not exist

defects.recommendation: Use verified LangGraph APIs compatible with the installed version.

testCases.description: A valid external repository using a different clean structure (false-positive prevention)

expected.notes: Valid external project layout evaluated without false positive structure flags

testCases.description: Insufficient evidence to confirm a defect leading to uncertainty recording

expected.notes: Context is external and cannot be verified statically; recorded as uncertainty

testCases.description: Duplicate symptoms of an invalid router consolidated into one root-cause finding

defects.recommendation: Consolidate duplicate routing symptoms into single root-cause finding.
